messages:
Maria Chen: Quick idea — we need a tighter visual "axiom" for the benchmark deck. Right now slides are scatterplots and tables; execs and PLG buyers keep asking "what does this mean for my monthly bill?". I want a single headline visual that answers: 'latency ÷ cost = user impact'.

Jack Rivera: +1. Three-panel approach could work: (1) distribution of latency (P50/P95) across models, (2) cost per 1k tokens at typical settings, (3) a before/after for optimization levers (batching + quantization). Simple copy: "Pay less. Serve faster. Same quality." :sparkles:

Lia Patel: Love that. For panel 3 can we show a concrete customer slice — e.g., 1M tokens/day chatbot for SMB vs enterprise? Make numbers tangible: dollars saved per month and latency improvement in ms.

Sam O'Neill: Mocked a quick data snippet — feel free to reuse in slides.
```
scenario,baseline_latency_ms,baseline_cost_per_m,optimized_latency_ms,optimized_cost_per_m
SMB-chat,320,1200,180,420
Enterprise-assist,240,5400,160,2100
```
Sam O'Neill: My takeaway: show both relative % and absolute $ to appeal to finance and eng. Also add tiny footnote: assumptions (token length, model flavor, quantization type).

Emily Zhang: For webinar positioning I propose this flow: 1) 5-min why latency×cost matters, 2) 10-min demo of our routing + optimize features reducing P95 and spend, 3) lightning Q&A + CTA (self-serve credits or request Dedicated trial). We should map CTAs to inbound routing buckets.

Maria Chen: Routing buckets draft: "trial-ready" ( >100k tokens/day + low latency target) -> SDR follow-up; "exploratory" -> nurture drip (case studies + cost calc tool); "technical" -> invite to hands-on workshop. We can capture intents via the webinar registration form (checkboxes + hidden tracking of feature clicks).

Jack Rivera: UX ask for deck: make the X-axis always cost (USD/month) so non-technical folks get orientation quickly. Use color to indicate latency bands (fast/ok/slow). Keep fonts large and annotate the sweet spot.

Lia Patel: Can someone draft the deck one-pager for the demo path? I'll own the customer slice numbers. Sam — can you drop the CSV into the shared drive and add a README with assumptions?

deploy-bot: New file uploaded: <https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/visual-axioms/1748203333-deck-raw.csv>

Sam O'Neill: Done — put the CSV in that folder and added a notes.md with token length = 20 avg, latency measured p95 over 1k requests, cost calc uses on-demand rates.

Emily Zhang: I'll mock up the webinar registration flow and mapping rules for the three buckets. Can we aim to have the visual draft + routing doc by EOD Friday?

Maria Chen: Yes — Friday EOD works. I'll synthesize the headline copy and send a 1-slide teaser for comms. Thanks all :raised_hands:
